diagnosis.root_cause: prepare_export computed the frozen packet checksum over native pre-transport GDScript doubles. Godot's full-precision JSON formatting is not idempotent across a JSON parse for accumulated fixed-tick movement doubles (e.g. x after 10 walk ticks at 6 m/s and 1/60 s): the first canonical round trip inside Protocol.seal can shorten the decimal representation, so the target's recomputed checksum over the delivered packet no longer matched the stored checksum and every legitimate handoff with real accumulated movement was rejected at the source attestation gate.
evidence: Deterministic reproduction: automatic (non-manual) graphical roundtrip at 91c0df9d failed with the same PROCESS_EXIT:client/a:1 and the same gateway marker.
Unit probe: Utils.payload_hash({'x': accumulated}) != Utils.payload_hash(json_round_trip(...)) for walk-speed fixed-tick positions (ticks 10, 11, 14, 19, ...).
Protocol.seal comment already documents the double-shortening behavior for MAC signing; prepare_export did not apply the same rule to the packet checksum.
diagnosis.defect_class: F: hash/token includes a field whose serialized representation changes on first JSON round trip
diagnosis.wrong_boundary: producer (source export freeze), not the validator

repair.principle: LEGITIMATE CURRENT SOURCE ATTESTATION -> PASS; STALE/FORGED/WRONG SOURCE -> FAIL (unchanged strictness)

New failure codes LIVE_PLAYER_EXPORT_CANONICALIZATION_FAILED / LIVE_PLAYER_EXPORT_CANONICALIZATION_UNSTABLE fail closed.

continuation_defect_r13b.context: attestation repair confirmed in manual run (route a->b->a completed, client-a/b json+png present); run then aborted on MVP3_CLIENT_COMMAND_REJECTED:LEDGER_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED
continuation_defect_r13b.root_cause: interactive clients submit one distinct fixed-tick operation per held tick (~120 ops/s for two players); the gateway operation ledger was configured with capacity 1024, which legitimate held-input movement exhausts in ~8.6 s. The P6 ledger is deliberately fail-closed with no eviction, so the capacity bound itself was mis-sized for the interactive session envelope.
repair: v0_mvp3_process_protocol.gd: MAX_INTERACTIVE_LEDGER_OPERATIONS = 16384 derived from the session envelope (2 players x 60 fixed ticks/s x 120 s gateway timeout = 14400) plus headroom
tests/runtime/test_v0_mvp3_gateway_ledger_budget.gd: envelope saturation never rejects legitimate operations; capacity enforcement beyond the bound still fails closed; exact replay consumes no slot

acceptance: fresh Windows manual executor run on the frozen repair HEAD with HUMAN_PHYSICAL_KEYBOARD; predicate closure reserved for the Independent Verifier
